personality_one_liner: A cinematic, moody, and deeply dramatic shared-screen experience inspired by medieval castles, candlelight, and betrayal.

spacing.rule: Generous vertical rhythm to accommodate older players. Large padding on buttons and list items.

do's: Use blur on modal scrims, sticky bottom CTAs, and overlay panels over background imagery.
Pair blur with a dark tint (e.g., surface color at 75% opacity) to ensure foreground text is highly readable.
dont's: Do not blur dense lists or form fields.
Do not rely solely on blur without a tint behind text.

screens.name: Welcome / Setup
screens.purpose: Configure the 10-15 players, set 4-digit PINs, and start the 12-day game.
screens.layout: Full-bleed background image of a dark castle with a heavy gradient scrim. A single 'Start Game' or 'Continue Game' button anchored at the bottom.

screens.name: Day Dashboard (Public Hub)
screens.purpose: The safe, public screen shown when passing the phone. Displays the current Day, alive players, and remaining lives.
screens.layout: Header shows 'Day X / 12'. Grid or list of players. Tapping a player initiates the PIN entry modal to enter their private view. Buttons must be large and accessible.

screens.name: PIN Entry Modal
screens.purpose: A gatekeeper screen to prevent players from seeing others' roles or actions.
screens.layout: Dark glass overlay with a large, legible numeric keypad. 'Hand the phone to [Player]' prominently displayed.

screens.name: Private Action (Role / Murder / Vote)
screens.purpose: Contextual private screen: reveals role on Day 1, allows Traitors to select a victim + secret physical action, or allows voting at the Round Table.
screens.layout: Centered, single-focus layout. If Traitor, show a form to pick a victim and type/select the 'in plain sight' action (e.g., 'Hand them a napkin'). Dark, moody background with candle imagery.

screens.name: Resolution Reveal
screens.purpose: The cinematic morning reveal of who was murdered and who was banished.
screens.layout: Dramatic typography, slow fade-in animations, wax seal envelope imagery. Focus heavily on storytelling.

hero_castle_bg.alt: Scottish castle at night in the fog

private_candle_bg.alt: Single lit candle in the dark

resolution_seal_bg.alt: Vintage envelope with a wax seal

instructions_to_main_agent: This is a shared-phone pass-and-play app. Navigation must be strictly Stack-based. There is no personal tab bar.

The primary demographic includes 60-year-olds. Touch targets MUST be large (minimum 56px, preferably 64px for primary actions). Typography must be highly legible; bump the base font size if necessary.

Implement the 'gradient-to-dark scrim' pattern strictly on all screens with background images. The scrim must fade from transparent to at least 80% opacity at the bottom so the overlaid white/gold text is perfectly readable.
The 'Day Dashboard' is the safe hub. From there, tapping a player triggers a PIN Entry modal before revealing any private information. Maintain this strict separation.

For the Traitor's 'in plain sight' murder feature, provide a clear text input or dropdown on their private screen to record the physical action (e.g., 'Offer a drink') they must perform to complete the murder.
Use the Cormorant Garamond display font generously for screen titles and dramatic reveals to nail the BBC 'The Traitors' aesthetic.
